# Kirsten Morel

Kirsten Morel is the current Deputy of [District 3](https://flow.je/elections/district-3) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2018.

Kirsten Morel has participated in 2 elections since 2002:

- [**2018 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kirsten-morel#e42)

  Elected as Deputy of St Lawrence with 86.9% of the ballot.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/kirsten-morel/)
  - [2018 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20191002222525/https://kirstenmorel.com/st-lawrence)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zdLPuHQOeoA)
  - [2018 Bailiwick Express Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ErUmfRrPRg8)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/kirsten-morel#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 3 with 70.8% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/kirstel-morel/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fp0ZAanAQyM)
  - [2022 Full Manifesto](https://img1.wsimg.com/blobby/go/16fc5646-32e3-49b2-be12-840c9913a8a7/Vote%20Morel%20%20A4%204pp%202022%20PRINT%20READY.pdf)
  - [2022 SCOOP Food Security Questionnaire](https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id=1kI5ESEJ4byHHwSp76kLGeBkayQSQynP9#page=7)

Kirsten Morel has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 3](https://flow.je/elections/district-3). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/02/economic-development-minister-to-stand-as-district-deputy-in-june-election/)\]

Links for Kirsten Morel:

- Facebook : [@kirsten4Jersey](https://www.facebook.com/kirsten4Jersey)

## Election History

### 2018 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Lawrence](https://flow.je/elections/st-lawrence) (2 seats), 16th May 2018.

**Kirsten Morel was elected as Deputy of St Lawrence in 2018**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Kirsten Morel** |  | 1,499 | 86.9% |
| 2 | **[Gregory Guida](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/gregory-guida)** |  | 1,194 | 69.2% |
| 3 | [Sarah Westwater](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/sarah-westwater) | [Reform Jersey](https://flow.je/elections/parties/reform-jersey) | 299 | 17.3% |

1,725 ballots (inc. 4 spoilt papers)

3,924 registered voters

= 44% turnout

### 2022 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [District 3](https://flow.je/elections/district-3) (3 seats), 22nd June 2022.

**Kirsten Morel was elected as Deputy of District 3 in 2022**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |

| 1 | **Kirsten Morel** |  | 2,688 | 70.8% |
| 2 | **[Hilary Jeune](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/hilary-jeune)** |  | 2,601 | 68.5% |
| 3 | **[Elaine Millar](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/elaine-millar)** |  | 2,241 | 59% |
| 4 | **[Andy Howell](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/andy-howell)** |  | 1,722 | 45.4% |
| 5 | [Gregory Guida](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/gregory-guida) | [Jersey Alliance](https://flow.je/elections/parties/jersey-alliance) | 1,166 | 30.7% |
| 6 | [John Le Fondré](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/john-le-fondre) | [Jersey Alliance](https://flow.je/elections/parties/jersey-alliance) | 997 | 26.3% |
| 7 | [Mary Venturini](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/mary-venturini) |  | 925 | 24.4% |
| 8 | [Hugh Raymond](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/hugh-raymond) | [Jersey Alliance](https://flow.je/elections/parties/jersey-alliance) | 421 | 11.1% |

3,796 ballots (inc. 17 spoilt papers)

8,002 registered voters

= 47.4% turnout
